scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic and self-contained up to classical comparison and Perron–Frobenius theorems. Exact symbolic identities and supplementary numerical corroboration are included. The self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous logistic threshold dynamics on finite row-stochastic networks at a tuned cusp. Strictly one-sided data required for reciprocal-square asymptotics; irreducibility for a shared constant. The spectral formula is linearized about nonstationary homogeneous orbits. No finite-population or field-data inference. Full Kaye PDF not inspected; potential broader theorem overlap remains.
title: Universal cusp relaxation with network-dependent spectral tails in logistic threshold-response dynamics
